# status of an inner province (1 heartland .. 5 despotate); before the monthly pulse first sets it, the status the
# pulse would give (gen_territory_status.py INIT); 0 when not an inner province

    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sx_inner = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_status } value = var:oe_theme_status }

        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_latin } value = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian } value = 4 }
        else = { value = 1 }
    }
}

            country_exists = c:BYZ
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_ts_levy_extra }

        else = { add = c:BYZ.var:oe_ts_levy_extra }
    }
    min = 0
}
